name: Distributor / Store Invoice Sub-Agent
title: Never86 report sub — Inventory / Par / Ordering / Distributor / Store Invoice
description: Owns the Distributor / Store Invoice report (Primary: phone photos of distributor invoices, grocery receipts, Register#2 payout slips (OCR). Bonus: emailed PDF/CSV when they forward.). Ingests photo, email, pdf, csv. Signals: vendor, sku, qty, amount, account, payout_pair, handwritten_credit, email_forward, source_channel, ocr_confidence, rotation_deg. Routes findings up to the domain parent; teach labels via Report Teacher.
source_report: Primary: phone photos of distributor invoices, grocery receipts, Register#2 payout slips (OCR). Bonus: emailed PDF/CSV when they forward.

teach_memory.label: keep
teach_memory.as_is: Small ICPs dump phone photos of every invoice — rotated, stapled payout↔receipt, shadows, blur. Millions of them.
teach_memory.truth: Email invoices exist, but most owner-1-5 ops will not reliably forward them. Photo OCR must work.
teach_memory.coach_to: Ingest the photo firehose via invoice-photo-ocr → vendor-invoice schema. Offer email forward as a later upgrade, not a prerequisite.
teach_memory.good_looks_like: Photo batch → auto-rotate OCR → vendor/date/amount/account rows with confidence flags. Low-confidence docs teach-batch to Myke.
